danielmcmenamy: Konrad Danielmcmena took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Water rose to the second step of the dugout. Konrad Danielmcmena moved a tin of tobacco to the highest shelf and sat beside it like a guard.

Konrad Danielmcmena found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: an old man with a dog, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire. A letter from home found Konrad Danielmcmena before the night shift. Konrad Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went through Konrad Danielmcmena's sleeve at R-F6 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. A letter from home found Konrad Danielmcmena before the night shift. Konrad Danielmcmena folded it small and kept it close.
